text:
anya: Quick idea for Q4 kickoff: coordinated 'Gratitude Desk-Drops' + a 10-min mini recognition pop-up per office. Postcard + small treat (tea bag + sticker) handed at desks or in locker for remote-friendly mailing. Tie to SpotAwards so managers can nominate at same time. Thoughts?
marisol: Love. We did something similar last year but it was ad-hoc. Can we standardize copy and a visual for the postcard? I can draft the design.
evan: Heads-up on international shipping costs — EU and APAC mail can get pricey. Recommend local vendor or printable PDF + local printers.
drew: I can coordinate vendors. Estimated costs: $2.20 per desk-drop (cards + treat) if printed/packed in SF; shipping bumps to $4-6 for international fulfillment.
jamie: Volunteer packers? I can mobilize 6 folks for an afternoon pack-and-label shift. Also have a list of remote addresses from HR (we'll need opt-in confirmation).
courier-bot: Reminder: office mailroom rules require packages logged 48h in advance for any external vendor deliveries.
anya: Good call. @facilities can we reserve the mailroom staging area on Nov 28 for drop-off + pickup?
facilities: Mailroom staging OK on Nov 28 09:00-17:00. Please provide vendor ETA and number of pallets/boxes. No more than 10 loose boxes during business hours; otherwise use freight elevator after hours.
marisol: I'll draft postcard copy. Proposed front: "Thanks for bringing your A-game" and back: short prefilled SpotAwards link QR and line: "Nominate a teammate now — scan to send a quick shoutout."
evan: About the SpotAwards linking: can we prefill team tag and reason? We can add ?tag=desk-drop&prefill=Gratitude to the URL but confirm app supports it.
people-ops-bot: Autoresponse: Use https://spotawards.internal/submit?tag=desk-drop to prefill tag. App supports a short 'reason' param.
jamie: Opt-in logistics: we'll send an opt-in form for remote employees collecting shipping address + PO box preferences. Need copy approval and privacy note (addresses used only for this initiative).
anya: Privacy note: addresses stored temporarily; will be deleted 30 days post-shipment. Need legal ok. @evan can you loop in legal?
evan: Looping legal now. Also note: gift tax thresholds differ by country; @finance-bot what's our allowance for non-cash treats and when do we need to record taxable benefit?
finance-bot: Quick guidance: de minimis non-cash items under $50 per person usually non-taxable in US. For other jurisdictions, consult regional payroll. We can budget for up to $60 per kit but payroll review required if exceed local thresholds.
drew: That's fine. Proposed budget: $2,500 for SF packing/printing, $3,200 for international local prints (split across vendors), contingency $800. Total ~ $6500.
marisol: I'll attach design mock and printer specs. Can we use uncoated cardstock and single-color print to reduce smudge on stickers?
anya: Yes. Also let's make postcards bilingual (EN/ES) for SF offices.
jamie: Volunteer schedule: packathon Nov 29 13:00-17:00. Who's in? I'll create a sign-up.
marisol: I can do print-ready files by Nov 10. Need final copy by Nov 7 to meet printer deadlines.
evan: Legal: approved privacy wording, make sure we set deletion reminder. Also flagged that UK payroll needs disclosure if kit value > £50. Suggest we keep EU/local kit values under that threshold or document in payroll.
people-ops-bot: Template: "I consent to provide my address for the purpose of receiving a company recognition kit. Address will be stored securely and deleted by [date]."
anya: Approvals: @finance-bot can you pre-approve vendor spend up to $7k under code 'culture-programs/gratitude'? We'll need PO and vendor invoices.
finance-bot: Pre-approval: up to $7,000 with PO attached and coded to 'culture-programs/gratitude'. Anything above requires director sign-off.
drew: I'll collect vendor quotes and request PO. Prefer smaller local printers in each region to cut customs.
marisol: Final question: do we want to run a micro pop-up recognition 10 min in each office (quick callout + play 1-2 clips of spot awards) or keep it low-key?
jamie: Micro pop-ups are fun but keep to 10 mins max. I'll trial SF on Dec 2 at 10:30 and see participation.
anya: Sounds good. Action items: marisol finalize copy by Nov 7; drew collect vendor quotes by Nov 9; jamie create volunteer sign-up and run SF pop-up draft Dec 2; evan confirm legal wording + payroll notes; finance to issue PO when quotes are in. I'll post consolidated timeline Friday. Thanks all! :sparkles:
